post.description: The primitive behind every "rows for this classroom in this term" read in another service. Callers used to reach these by joining `student_enrollments` from their own tables; they resolve ids here and filter on their own foreign key instead. At least one filter is required — an unfiltered search is a whole-table read, not a query.
